verdict.rationale: Ramp offers its own business checking through a partner bank, and its Banking API only reads a Ramp business's own cash position. There is no evidence of a banking-as-a-service product that lets a developer embed deposit accounts for their own customers. The partner Applications API only pre-fills a Ramp application that the applicant finishes in Ramp's UI, which is a referral into Ramp's product, not embedded accounts offered under the developer's platform.

support.subject: As a developer, I can offer embedded banking accounts to my customers without holding my own financial license
